name: national-captures
rules:
SecAction "id:1,phase:1,pass,setvar:tx.0=old"
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Example "@validateNid cl [0-9Kk.-]+" "id:2,phase:1,pass,capture"
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:More "@validateNid cl [0-9Kk.-]+" "id:3,phase:1,pass"
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Other "@validateNid us [0-9-]+" "id:4,phase:1,pass"
SecAction "id:5,phase:1,pass,msg:'%{tx.0}|%{tx.1}|%{tx.2}'"

name: geo-strmatch
rules:
SecAction "id:1,phase:1,pass,setvar:tx.0=prior,setvar:tx.needle=ET"
SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@strmatch %{tx.needle}" "id:2,phase:1,pass,capture"
SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@strmatch et" "id:3,phase:1,pass"
SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@geoLookup" "id:4,phase:1,pass,capture"
SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "!@geoLookup" "id:5,phase:1,pass"
SecRule &GEO "@eq 0" "id:6,phase:1,pass,msg:'%{tx.0}'"

name: body-json-media
rules:
SecRequestBodyAccess On
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Mode "@streq json" "id:1,phase:1,pass,ctl:requestBodyProcessor=JSON"
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Mode "@streq xml" "id:2,phase:1,pass,ctl:requestBodyProcessor=XML"
SecRule ARGS:json.sample "@streq value" "id:3,phase:2,pass"
SecRule XML:/* "@streq value" "id:4,phase:2,pass"
SecRule ARGS:sample "@streq value" "id:5,phase:2,pass"

name: connector-path-limit
rules:
SecArgumentsLimit 2
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@restpath /{Item}" "id:1,phase:1,pass"
SecRule &ARGS_PATH:item "@eq 2" "id:2,phase:1,pass"
SecRule ARGS_PATH:item "@streq blue" "id:3,phase:1,pass,msg:'%{MATCHED_VAR_NAME}'"
SecRule ARGS_PATH:item "@streq second" "id:4,phase:1,pass,msg:'%{MATCHED_VAR_NAME}'"
SecRule ARGUMENTS_LIMIT_REACHED "@streq 1" "id:5,phase:1,pass"
SecRule &ARGS_PATH:extra "@eq 0" "id:6,phase:1,pass"
